## Details
### **SW-REQ-AFM-APP-001** — Scheduled Execution at Static Period

- **Description:** The AFM app shall execute on the scheduler at a fixed compile-time period.
- **Rationale:** Parent SYS-010 mandates a static compile-time schedule for deterministic TDM execution of all apps.
- **Verification Method:** Inspection
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-010
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-AFM-APP-002** — Sensor Message Subscription

- **Description:** The AFM app shall subscribe to IMU, barometer, and GPS sensor messages on the software bus.
- **Rationale:** PM-required AFM capability per SYS-016 needs sensor measurements to drive flight phase detection.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-016
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-AFM-APP-003** — Navigation State Subscription

- **Description:** The AFM app shall subscribe to navigation state messages on the software bus.
- **Rationale:** PM-required AFM capability per SYS-016 uses nav state alongside sensors to detect flight phases.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-016
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-AFM-APP-004** — Phase Detection Update Per Cycle

- **Description:** The AFM app shall update the flight phase detection state each scheduled cycle using received messages.
- **Rationale:** PM-required AFM capability per SYS-016 mandates ongoing phase detection during the mission.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-016
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-AFM-APP-005** — Current Flight Phase Publication

- **Description:** The AFM app shall publish the current flight phase on the software bus each scheduled cycle.
- **Rationale:** Parent SYS-017 requires the current flight phase to be observable on the bus for telemetry and logging.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-017
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-AFM-APP-006** — Phase Transition Timestamp Publication

- **Description:** The AFM app shall publish a timestamp on the software bus for each detected flight phase transition.
- **Rationale:** Parent SYS-018 requires transition timestamps to support post-flight ground-truth comparison within one second.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-018
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-AFM-APP-007** — Defined Flight Phase Set

- **Description:** The AFM app shall report flight phase as one of pre-launch, boost, apogee, descent, or landing.
- **Rationale:** Parent SYS-016 mandates detection of boost, apogee, descent, and landing phases plus pre-launch ground state.
- **Verification Method:** Inspection
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-016
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-AFM-APP-008** — Fault Isolation From Other Apps

- **Description:** The AFM app shall not prevent other applications from executing when its own execution fails.
- **Rationale:** Parent SYS-062 mandates apps continue at static rates when phase detection is unavailable.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-062
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-AFM-APP-009** — POSIX and Flight Build Equivalence

- **Description:** The AFM app shall produce identical published phase outputs on POSIX and flight builds for identical inputs.
- **Rationale:** Parent SYS-043 requires POSIX build to be functionally equivalent to flight build for Trick simulation fidelity.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-043
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-AFM-APP-010** — Deterministic Phase Output

- **Description:** The AFM app shall produce deterministic phase outputs when given identical input message sequences.
- **Rationale:** Parent SYS-044 mandates deterministic FSW outputs for repeatable Trick sim runs and regression analysis.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-044
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1
